title: Big cinematic impact
description: "Big cinematic impact" (Mixkit SFX #788). Deep cinematic boom (7.9 s) with a short air swell (from ~0.9 s) into the hit at ~2.18 s and a long low tail. Measured: 7.94 s, RMS -19.1 dBFS, -15.8 LUFS, onset 0.88 s, loudest at 2.18 s, audible to 6.49 s, brightness centroid 242 Hz.
suggested_use: Logo lock-up hit: start the file 2.18 s before the logo lands. Keep it 6-10 dB under a full-scale mix so it adds weight, not darkness.
judged_by: title/tags on the source page plus measured spectrogram and loudness envelope (not auditioned by ear)
